info.title: OpsDesk API
info.description: Tenant-scoped support operations API. Use the Next.js BFF for browser requests; Auth0 bearer tokens belong on the API boundary. See docs/api/README.md for workflows and Socket.IO events. No real credentials or account details are embedded.

servers.description: Local API only; configure deployment URLs privately

auth0.description: Auth0 access token with the configured API audience and issuer; never an ID token.

svix.name: svix-signature
svix.description: Verified Resend/Svix signature. Also requires svix-id and svix-timestamp; the signature covers the exact raw body.

token.description: Invitation secret. Never log or publish it.

membershipId.description: Assignable membership in this organization; null clears the assignee. VIEWER memberships cannot be assigned.

acceptanceToken.description: One-time invitation secret. Never log or publish this value.

url.description: Short-lived signed URL; treat as a secret.
